Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Allowed: - Zidovudine (AZT), but must be suspended during study medication.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Unequivocal diagnosis of Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia established by morphologic confirmation of three or more typical Pneumocystis carinii organisms in sputum, bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, or lung tissue obtained by transbronchial or open-lung biopsy within 3 days before or after randomization.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description provides no evidence of Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia diagnosis or morphologic confirmation.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Resting (A-a) DO2 less than 30 torr on room air at all ACTG sites except San Francisco General Hospital. Non-ACTG sites will enter patients up to a resting (A-a) DO2 less than 55 mmHg on room air.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient data does not include resting (A-a) DO2 measurements.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of dyspnea, cough, or bronchospasm in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of major adverse reaction to pentamidine or sulfonamide-containing preparation defined as: - Absolute neutropenia of 750 or less PMN + bands cells/mm3.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No history of pentamidine/sulfonamide adverse reactions or neutropenia reported.
Platelet count data not provided in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Rise in creatinine: To more than 3.0 mg/dl.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No creatinine level data provided in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Liver function abnormalities: SGOT or SGPT greater than 5 x upper limit of normal.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Mild hepatic transaminase elevation reported, but exact SGOT/SGPT values and upper limit of normal not specified.
No hypoglycemic episodes or glucose levels below 50 mg/dl reported.
No rash or mucositis reported in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of unremitting cough or bronchospasm in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No concurrent medications for AIDS/PCP or Zidovudine (AZT) reported.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No systemic steroid use reported in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No prior antiprotozoal regimen, sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim, pyrimethamine, sulfadoxine/pyrimethamine, pentamidine, or eflornithine reported.
